overview.topic: 🔎 애니메이션 감독 Chuck Jones의 생애와 업적
overview.stance_reason: an influential director, famous characters, an Honorary Academy Award 등 업적 중심의 서술
overview.structure_reason: born in 1912 → 1930 경력 시작 → 1940s 캐릭터 → 1970 회사 → 1996 수상 → late in his life 순서로 전개

key_grammar.source_sentence: Chuck Jones was an influential director and artist whose work shaped animated films and cartoon production.

explanation.text: whose는 '그 사람의/그것의'라는 소유의 뜻을 지닌 관계대명사로, 두 문장을 하나로 잇는다.
선행사(사람·사물) + whose + 명사: whose 바로 뒤에 '소유되는 명사'가 관사 없이 온다.
artist whose work = an artist and his work: 예술가(선행사)가 work(작품)를 소유하는 관계다.
who's(=who is/has)와 혼동하지 않는다. 뒤에 명사가 오면 소유격 whose다.
of which로도 풀 수 있다: an artist the work of whom / of which shaped ~.

key_grammar.example_analysis: whose work shaped ~ = 선행사 artist가 work를 소유하고, 그 work가 shaped의 주어가 되는 소유격 관계사절.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: Chuck Jones [[1|was]] an influential director [[2|and]] artist [[3|who]] work [[4|shaped]] [[5|animated]] films and cartoon production.
drills.fix: who → whose: 뒤 명사 work를 수식하며 선행사 artist가 그것을 소유하는 관계이므로 소유격 관계대명사 whose가 옳다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: He used the leftover pencils and paper [[that/what]] his father [[brought/brought to]] him from work.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: Chuck Jones was an influential director and artist whom work shaped animated films and cartoon production.
drills.fix: whom → whose: 뒤 명사 work를 수식하는 소유 관계이므로 소유격 관계대명사 whose가 옳다.
options: Jones began his career in animation in 1930 and was quickly promoted.
Chuck Jones was an influential director and artist whom work shaped animated films and cartoon production.
In the 1940s, he created famous characters such as Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner.
He directed the famous cartoon film How the Grinch Stole Christmas, which is still enjoyed by many people today.
For his contribution to the field of animation, he received an Honorary Academy Award in 1996.

drills.question: 그는 소설이 여러 언어로 번역된 작가를 만났다.
drills.answer: He met a writer whose novels were translated into several languages.

sentences.english: Chuck Jones was an influential director and artist whose work shaped animated films and cartoon production.

grammar.note: whose work = 선행사(artist)의 작품 — 소유 관계

chunks.en: Chuck Jones was an influential director and artist
whose work shaped animated films and cartoon production.
chunks.ko: 그의 작품이 애니메이션 영화와 만화 제작을 [[형성했다]]

misreads.statement: Chuck Jones는 애니메이션 영화와 만화 제작에 영향을 준 감독이자 예술가였다.
필자는 Chuck Jones를 높이 평가하지만, 그 근거를 그의 상업적 흥행 수익 때문이라고 본다.
misreads.anchor: an influential director and artist whose work shaped animated films and cartoon production
misreads.why: 긍정적 평가는 맞지만 근거는 수익이 아니라 작품이 이 분야를 형성한 영향력이다.

mistips: whose 뒤에는 관사 없이 명사(work)가 바로 온다.

sentences.english: He was born in Spokane, Washington, in 1912, though he grew up in Los Angeles.

chunks.en: He was born in Spokane, Washington, in 1912,
though he grew up in Los Angeles.

misreads.statement: Chuck Jones가 어린 시절을 보낸 곳은 그가 태어난 도시인 Spokane이다.
misreads.anchor: though he grew up in Los Angeles
misreads.why: 태어난 곳은 Spokane이지만 자란 곳은 Los Angeles로 서로 다른 도시다.

mistips: born in ~(태어난 곳)과 grew up in ~(자란 곳)을 분리해 읽는다.

sentences.english: As a child, Jones had many opportunities to draw.

grammar.note: opportunities to draw = 그릴 기회(명사 수식)

chunks.en: As a child, Jones had
many opportunities to draw.

misreads.statement: Jones는 어린 시절 정식 미술 학교에 다니며 그림 그릴 기회를 얻었다.
misreads.anchor: Jones had many opportunities to draw
misreads.why: 많은 기회를 가졌다고만 했을 뿐 정식 미술 학교 언급은 없다.

mistips: opportunities to draw : to draw가 앞 명사를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이다.

sentences.english: He used the leftover pencils and paper that his father brought him from work.

grammar.note: that = pencils and paper를 선행사로 받는 목적격 관계사

chunks.en: He used the leftover pencils and paper
that his father brought him from work.

misreads.statement: Jones는 아버지가 직장에서 가져다준 남은 연필과 종이를 사용했다.

mistips: that ~ brought : 목적어가 빠진 목적격 관계사절로 앞 명사를 수식한다.

sentences.english: Jones began his career in animation in 1930 and was quickly promoted.

grammar.note: began ... and was promoted = 술어 병렬

chunks.en: Jones began his career in animation in 1930
and was quickly promoted.

misreads.statement: Jones는 자신의 회사를 차린 덕분에 애니메이션 경력을 빠르게 시작할 수 있었다.
misreads.anchor: began his career in animation in 1930
misreads.why: 경력 시작(1930)은 자기 회사 설립(1970)보다 앞서므로 회사 덕분이라는 인과가 성립하지 않는다.

mistips: began ~ and was promoted : and가 두 술어를 병렬로 이어 준다.

sentences.english: In the 1940s, he created famous characters such as Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner.

chunks.en: In the 1940s, he created famous characters
such as Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner.

misreads.statement: Jones adapted the Road Runner from another studio's work.
misreads.anchor: he created famous characters such as Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner
misreads.why: 이 캐릭터들은 Jones가 직접 created(창작)한 것으로 다른 스튜디오의 각색이 아니다.

mistips: such as 뒤는 앞 명사(characters)의 구체적 예시다.

sentences.english: He directed the famous cartoon film How the Grinch Stole Christmas, which is still enjoyed by many people today.

grammar.note: is still enjoyed by = 즐겨진다(현재 수동)

chunks.en: He directed the famous cartoon film
How the Grinch Stole Christmas,
which is still enjoyed by many people today.

misreads.statement: How the Grinch Stole Christmas는 오늘날에는 거의 잊혀 사람들에게 즐겨지지 않는다.
misreads.anchor: which is still enjoyed by many people today
misreads.why: 여전히(still) 많은 사람이 즐긴다고 했으므로 잊혔다는 것은 반대다.

mistips: , which : 콤마 뒤 which는 앞의 영화를 보충 설명하는 계속적 용법이다.

sentences.english: Jones started his own company, Chuck Jones Enterprises, in 1970.

grammar.note: his own company, Chuck Jones Enterprises = 동격
his own company = 자기 자신의 회사

chunks.en: Jones started his own company,
Chuck Jones Enterprises, in 1970.

misreads.statement: Jones는 명예 아카데미상을 받은 뒤 자신의 회사를 설립했다.
misreads.anchor: Jones started his own company, Chuck Jones Enterprises, in 1970
misreads.why: 회사 설립은 1970년, 명예상 수상은 1996년으로 회사 설립이 먼저다.

mistips: his own company와 Chuck Jones Enterprises는 같은 대상을 가리키는 동격이다.

sentences.english: For his contribution to the field of animation, he received an Honorary Academy Award in 1996.

chunks.en: For his contribution to the field of animation,
he received an Honorary Academy Award in 1996.

misreads.statement: Jones는 애니메이션 분야에 대한 공로로 1996년 명예 아카데미상을 받았다.

mistips: For his contribution : For는 '~에 대한 공로로'라는 이유를 나타낸다.

sentences.english: Late in his life, he established a non-profit organization supporting art education and other creative skills.

chunks.en: Late in his life,
he established a non-profit organization
supporting art education and other creative skills.
chunks.ko: [[미술 교육]]과 그 밖의 창의적 기술을 지원하는

misreads.statement: Jones가 말년에 세운 비영리 단체는 은퇴한 애니메이터들의 생계를 지원하기 위한 것이었다.
misreads.anchor: supporting art education and other creative skills
misreads.why: 단체는 미술 교육과 창의적 기술을 지원하는 것으로 은퇴자 생계 지원은 언급이 없다.

mistips: organization supporting ~ : 분사 supporting이 앞의 단체를 뒤에서 꾸민다.
